name: background-gradient-animation

frames.best_why: The central orb is at its largest and most saturated pink, filling the middle of the field.

tagline: A purple gradient field with a huge glowing orb that drifts and changes hue.
summary: A full-screen animated backdrop of blurred coloured light blobs rotating over a purple-to-indigo gradient. The centre swells into a warm orb that shifts between yellow and pink, and a sixth glow follows the pointer.
appearance: A full purple-to-indigo gradient field with a huge soft glowing orb in the middle that fades from warm yellow through pink. Everything is heavily blurred, and a faint blue light patch trails the cursor across the field.
behaviour: Five coloured blobs drift and rotate continuously over the purple base, so the central glow swells and changes hue without ever settling. Moving the pointer drags a sixth coloured patch along with it.
search_phrases: animated gradient background with glowing orb
css animated gradient for landing page
use_when: A hero or full-page backdrop that needs a soft living gradient with no content of its own.
avoid_when: Nested layouts: it fills the viewport and writes CSS variables onto the whole body.
customise: Every colour, the gradient ends, blob size, blending mode and the pointer toggle are props; the five animation keyframes live in the theme CSS.
weight_why: Six blurred full-size blobs composited with blend modes plus a pointer glow.

a11y.note: Purely decorative divs that animate forever with no reduced-motion handling.

issues: The blobs merge into one shapeless orb, so the five separate gradients are hard to read.
It writes CSS variables onto document.body, leaking colours to the whole page.
It fills the viewport with h-screen and w-screen, ignoring any container.
The animation never pauses, even off screen.
polish_why: Rich colour field and smooth drifting blur; the blobs merge into one shapeless orb.
